summary: Iteration 3 (Owner/HR roles, removed Jobs/Venues, PDF export, map fix, rename Technician->Employee) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 19/19 PASS (auth roles, staff gating, removed endpoints 404, analytics pivot, PDF export). Frontend Playwright: Owner & HR both land at /admin with correct role-badge ('Owner'/'HR'); sidebar contains only [Live Monitor, Analytics, Employees, Updates Feed, Attendance] - no Jobs/Venues; /admin/jobs, /admin/venues, /app/jobs all redirect to /login (routes removed); OSM tiles render on Live Monitor (16 tiles loaded, NOT blank) with dark filter; 'Field Employees' header, no 'Technician' wording in admin shell; Employees tab shows Export PDF button which downloads a valid %PDF (Rahul_Sharma_report.pdf); Employee app shows exactly 3 bottom tabs (Home, Updates, Alerts).

minor.issue: updates_last_7_days / updates_today still use fragile YYYY-MM-DD string vs ISO datetime prefix comparison (carry-over from iter 1/2). Works but should compare against ISO day bounds.
No validation that target user_id is role='employee' - staff could export another staff member's report. Low risk but inconsistent with delete_employee filter.
Notification title hardcodes 'Marked Red by Owner' / 'Contact Owner Immediately' even when HR triggers the flag - copy should be role-neutral (e.g. 'Marked Red by Management').

ui_bugs.issue: Left-pane description still reads 'Track every technician, every install' and tagline 'AUDIO COMMAND CENTER'. The rename Technician->Employee was applied to admin shell but missed on the public login page.

issues: When zero updates exist, the pie panel shows 'No update data yet.' which is correct empty-state, but the legend/axis area is large and looks empty. Consider compacting the empty state.

When an employee has 'No GPS' the Directions cell is blank (correct). Confirmed: data-testid='directions-{id}' only appears when live coords exist - test could not exercise it because seeded Rahul has no live ping.

action_items: (Low) Update Login.js hero copy: replace 'Track every technician' with 'Track every employee' and 'AUDIO COMMAND CENTER' tagline review for consistency with rename.
(Optional) Validate role='employee' in GET /api/users/{id}/export to prevent staff-on-staff export.
(Optional) Make flag notification titles role-neutral so HR-triggered flags don't say 'by Owner'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L592 deletes legacy admin role on every startup - fine for migration but could be guarded by a one-time migration flag to avoid surprise deletions in future deploys.
server.py L585 ensure_user always re-sets role on every startup - if an account's role is changed via DB it will be silently overwritten. Document this or restrict to seed accounts.

PDF export uses synchronous reportlab inside async endpoint - acceptable for small reports but could block event loop for large attendance histories (200+ records). Consider running in threadpool (await asyncio.to_thread).
STAFF_ROLES still includes legacy 'admin' even though startup deletes them - dead code; remove from set for clarity.
Login endpoint lacks brute-force lockout (carry-over from iter 1/2).

To test 'Directions' link, a live_location.ping must be posted for an employee first.
rca of the issue: Map fix: switching from CartoDB (blocked in sandbox/preview egress) to OpenStreetMap tiles plus a ResizeObserver invalidateSize call resolved the blank map. Verified 16 leaflet-tile elements rendered in DOM under .leaflet-container. PDF export: reportlab Canvas generates a 1-page A4 with gold/dark branding, attendance summary and last 14 updates - download verified with %PDF magic bytes and Content-Disposition attachment header. Role separation: STAFF_ROLES = {owner, hr, admin} on backend; require_admin returns 403 for employee tokens (verified). Frontend ProtectedRoute with staff prop correctly redirects /admin/jobs and /admin/venues (now non-existent routes) to /login.
